priorityList: Use Avenging Wrath (or Radiant Glory) on cooldown, ideally synced with Trinkets and Potions.
Cast Execution Sentence if Wake of Ashes is available and the target will survive 10 seconds.
Spend Holy Power if you are at max (5) or if the Hammer of Light free proc is about to expire.
Cast Hammer of Light as your highest priority spender.
Cast Divine Storm if 3+ enemies are present or if Empyrean Power is active.
Cast Templar's Verdict as your spender if Divine Storm conditions are not met.
Cast Wake of Ashes on cooldown, ensuring you do not overcap Holy Power.
Cast Blade of Justice if Art of War or Righteous Cause procs.
Cast Hammer of Wrath as a priority generator if Walk into Light is talented.
Cast Blade of Justice to generate Holy Power.
Cast Hammer of Wrath to generate Holy Power.
Cast Judgment to generate Holy Power and apply debuffs.
Cast Templar Strike and Templar Slash as filler generators.
Use Crusader Strike or Arcane Torrent as a final priority to generate Holy Power.
